unified_frozen_protocol.definition: same task + same input + same scorer + same model capability; only whether decomposition is applied differs
unified_frozen_protocol.design_decision_v1_1: Three arms, not two. Mono-L vs DAG-L/L isolates the pure decomposition effect; DAG-L/L vs DAG-L/M isolates stage-level heterogeneous model allocation. Comparing Mono-L directly against DAG-L/M would confound decomposition with reasoning-model choice.

reasoning.input: facts parsed from the large-extraction output; NEVER gold

DAG-L/L.execution: exec_calc over v0..v_{n-1} with the same facts; tolerance 1e-4 rel

extraction.input: question + raw context (SHARED extraction with DAG-L/L)

research_questions.RQ-A: Mono-L vs DAG-L/L -> does decomposition itself help?
research_questions.RQ-B: DAG-L/L vs DAG-L/M -> does heterogeneous stage allocation help after decomposition?

unified_frozen_protocol.extraction_parse_failure_policy: deterministic DAG failure for BOTH DAG arms; NO gold fallback, NO retry; reasoning not called
unified_frozen_protocol.collection_policy: all three arms re-collected in one unified inference session (default); legacy cells are accuracy-reusable but latency is not comparable across sessions
unified_frozen_protocol.answer_normalization: regex Answer: <number> for mono; JSON expression for DAG reasoning

rerun_plan.policy: FULL FRESH unified session (default): every arm re-collected in one inference environment after RealDetector completes; single-session Quality/Tokens/Latency accounting. Legacy reuse remains possible for accuracy-only reporting (documented in legacy_reuse_option) but is NOT the default for the formal paper results.

session.model_grouping: large: mono(300) -> extraction(300) -> DAG-L/L reasoning(<=300); then medium: DAG-L/M reasoning(<=300)
session.gpu_guard: engine.start_model refuses to start when GPU busy or port 8128 occupied (protects RealDetector)
session.resume: keyed ledger; completed keys skipped on resume

expected_calls.note: parse-failure estimate from legacy extraction (MH 13 + TQ-old 2 + TQ-new 9); fresh extraction decides at runtime

legacy_reuse_option.mono: 100 MH + 160 TQ legacy mono rows are protocol-identical (same prompt/model/checkpoint, temp 0); accuracy-reusable
legacy_reuse_option.dag_actual_cells: MH large-extraction 100 (FSC), TQ large-extraction 200 (40 tqb + 160 scale_up), TQ new-160 medium reasoning 151
legacy_reuse_option.invalid_forever: gold-fed old-40 reasoning, 9+4 gold-fallback reasoning answers, FSC gold-conditioned reasoning, live static mixed-model arm

total_new_calls_breakdown.note: superseded by expected_calls under the full-fresh policy; minimal-cell plan was 165 (87 MH rsn-M + 40 TQ mono + 38 TQ rsn-M)

analysis.paired_delta: Delta_i = I(armA_i correct) - I(armB_i correct); mean + paired bootstrap 95% CI (10k resamples, seed 20260916)

analysis.table_A: Mono-L vs DAG-L/L (pure decomposition), per dataset + overall
analysis.table_B: DAG-L/L vs DAG-L/M (heterogeneous allocation), per dataset + overall
analysis.complexity_stratification: n_ops buckets 1-2 / 3 / 4+, computed on Table-A pair (Mono-L vs DAG-L/L) ONLY
